field_boundaries.annex_ata_rating: Annex D1 labels an ATA Rating column. It is a weapon-side attack field, not a target's Maneuver Rating. The six D1 ASCM rows listed below have blank cells in that column.

target_maneuver_rating.meaning: No numeric value is assigned here. Null does not mean MR 0, does not prove a per-model MR is missing, and does not establish that every missile target requires an MR value.
conflicting_context: HV2026 §8.1.1 includes missiles or aircraft in the bogey definition and step 9 subtracts bogey MR.
The official Kh-22N SAM example has no additional MR deduction, but does not state a universal missile-target exemption.
The SAM/AAM table footnote names non-maneuvering aircraft; the AA-gun missile rule is in a separate gun-modifier procedure.

field_boundaries.source_remarks: Store only the printed row letters and cited note text. Do not convert those notes to terminal_maneuvers, high_diving, maneuver_rating, or a live maneuvering boolean without an independently resolved rule and time-state binding.
field_boundaries.current_runtime_note: Static source and data audit only. Current AAW SAM preparation rejects a target profile with no numeric MR; whether the general missile procedure requires that value remains unresolved.
